description: The file defines a singleton class LongValueValidator that extends AbstractHeaderValueValidator. Its purpose is to validate long (64-bit integer) values parsed from CharSequence objects, throwing a DittoHeaderInvalidException if parsing fails.

classes.name: LongValueValidator
classes.description: Singleton class providing validation for long-type header values in the Ditto model.

methods.name: LongValueValidator.getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LongValueValidator.

methods.name: LongValueValidator.validateValue
methods.description: Validates that the provided CharSequence can be parsed into a long; throws exception if parsing fails.
